items: Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency proclaimed under Article 352.
Financial Emergency under Article 360 has never been declared in India so far.
Article 226 gives High Courts wider writ jurisdiction than Article 32 gives to the Supreme Court.
Article 44 directs the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) for all citizens.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 14 guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
Article 21 protection of life and personal liberty is a foundational right that cannot be suspended during an emergency.
Article 32 confers the right to remedies for enforcement of Fundamental Rights via writs like Habeas Corpus and Mandamus.
Emergency Provisions are covered under Article 352 (National), Article 356 (President's Rule), and Article 360 (Financial).
Article 368 lays down the Parliament's power and procedure to amend the Constitution.
